claims.claim: The font-family property lists one or more prioritized font families and generic family names.
The font-size property sets the size of a font and updates font-size-relative length units.
The available font weights depend on the current font family.
Line-height sets line-box height in horizontal writing modes and is commonly used for the distance between lines.
A unitless line-height can be calculated by multiplying the element's font size by the number.
An 18px font with unitless line-height 1.5 yields 27px when multiplied.
